description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of frames and memory usage for several models. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Frames" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000, with tick labels at intervals of 200. The y-axis is labeled "Memory (GB)" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick labels at intervals of 50. 

The red dashed line, representing VideoLLaMB, begins at approximately 5 GB at 0 frames and increases to approximately 160 GB at 1000 frames, with a sharp increase between 200 and 400 frames, rising from around 25 GB to 280 GB. The light green solid line, representing VideoLLaMB-R, starts at approximately 3 GB at 0 frames and increases to approximately 150 GB at 1000 frames, showing a generally steady increase. The dark green dashed line, representing VideoLLaMB-R, begins at approximately 4 GB at 0 frames and increases to approximately 60 GB at 1000 frames, with a relatively consistent upward trend. The blue dotted line, representing LLaVA-NeXT, starts at approximately 2 GB at 0 frames and increases to approximately 160 GB at 1000 frames, with a sharp increase between 200 and 400 frames, rising from around 20 GB to 280 GB. The purple dashed-dotted line, representing VideoLAVA, begins at approximately 1 GB at 0 frames and increases to approximately 170 GB at 1000 frames, with a sharp increase between 200 and 400 frames, rising from around 10 GB to 250 GB.
